question.html:
A negatively charged particle is moved away from a positively charged sphere. Which of the following are not inversely proportional to the distance between the particle and the centre of the sphere?

I. The electric force on the negatively charged particle due to the sphere.

II. The electrical potential energy of the negatively charged particle.

III. The electric field strength due to the sphere at the position of the negatively charged particle.

  1. I and II only
  2. I and III only
  3. II and III only
  4. I, II and III
